title: Neither a Picasso nor a Leonardo da Vinci: An Examination of Novice Artwork Pricing with Multimodal Data
authors: Sharmistha Sikdar, Ishita Chakraborty, Nika Dogonadze

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for: Neither a Picasso nor a Da Vinci: An Examination of Novice Artwork Pricing with Multimodal Data

eligible_reason: No DiD. Study 1 is a cross-sectional hedonic regression on Etsy listings, Study 2 a multimodal deep-learning price model, Study 3 a Cox proportional hazards model of time to sale.
design_notes: Code folders: 'Linear Model and Desc Stats_Study 1 Code' (R/SAS), 'MMF-DL_Study 2 Code' (PyTorch), 'Hazards Model_Study 3 Code' (coxph with start/stop), LDA notebooks, Etsy scraping/processing code. Six data/code files are restricted (complete_data.csv, EtsyCleanMainData, train/test data, newdata_july8, data2.py); complete_data.sas7bdat is public.
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract and code structure.
main_text_note: Article confirms hedonic regression, multimodal deep learning and a Cox hazard model (38 hazard mentions); no DiD terms.
